visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Inside a brightly lit DIY workshop featuring wooden workbenches, a young girl with bangs wearing a brown sleeveless top sits attentively. An adult male with glasses and a black shirt stands behind her, guiding her small hands as they interact with metal stamping tools and a hammer. (2) The scene cuts to another, younger toddler girl in a dark teal dress. She is being assisted by an older woman to use a small hammer. They are striking a metal stamp placed on a small gold-colored brass piece. (3) Close-up shots highlight the children's expressions of intense focus and curiosity as they participate in the metalworking process. Various metal stamps and tools are scattered on the wooden surface. (4) The children proudly showcase the completed keychains. One is shaped like a carrot with the name 'LEMON' stamped into it, and another is shaped like an elephant. (5) The video concludes with a transition to a solid pink screen featuring a small cartoon girl illustration and the text 'POPO'S DAILY LIFE'.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat, cheerful acoustic guitar BGM plays throughout. A male voice and a female voice engage in high-valence conversation with children. (2) Rhythmic, sharp metallic 'clinking' sounds of a hammer hitting a metal stamp occur frequently, synchronized with the visual actions. (3) A child's voice excitedly says 'Lemon' and 'Elephant' with high pitch and rising intonation. (4) The BGM continues steadily as the adults praise the children's work. (5) A short melodic synthesizer jingle plays during the outro transition.
